description: This file defines a Go package 'events' that manages reasoner events, including event types, event structures, an event bus for broadcasting events, and helper functions for publishing specific event types such as online, offline, updated, node status changes, refresh, and heartbeat events. It also includes a heartbeat goroutine to periodically send heartbeat events.

classes.name: ReasonerEventType
classes.description: String type representing different reasoner event types.

classes.name: ReasonerEvent
classes.description: Struct representing a reasoner event with type, IDs, status, timestamp, and optional data.

classes.name: ReasonerEventBus
classes.description: Struct managing subscribers and broadcasting reasoner events.

methods.name: NewReasonerEventBus
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new ReasonerEventBus instance.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Adds a new subscriber channel to the event bus.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscriber channel from the event bus.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Broadcasts an event to all subscribers.

methods.name: GetSubscriberCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active subscribers.

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Converts a ReasonerEvent to its JSON string representation.

methods.name: StartHeartbeat
methods.description: Starts a goroutine that sends periodic heartbeat events at specified intervals.
